methods.label: Boil
methods.intro: The most reliable method. If you have fuel, use this first.
steps: If the water is cloudy, filter it through a clean cloth and let it settle. Use only the clear water on top.
Bring to a rolling boil, then boil 1 more minute. At high altitude (over 2,000 m), 3 minutes.
Let it cool with a lid on and store it in a clean container.

methods.label: Bleach
methods.intro: When you cannot use fire. Use only unscented household bleach.
steps: Check the chlorine strength on the label. For 6–8%, use 2 drops per 1 L of water, 4 drops if cloudy.
It should smell slightly of chlorine. If not, add the same amount again and wait 15 more minutes.

methods.label: Sunlight
methods.intro: When you have no fuel or chemicals. Works only with clear water.
steps: Fill a clear plastic PET bottle (2 L or smaller) with clear water and close the cap.
Lay it in full sun for 6 hours. If it is very cloudy, 2 days.
Cloudy water, colored bottles and glass bottles work less well.
